methodology.boardSeed: Eight deterministic bytes: ASCII CODE followed by a big-endian 1-based board index.
methodology.decisionSeed: Matches Play runtime: board seed, turn number, and history length for each action.
methodology.clueSelection: Prefer the highest-scoring multi clue when it is within 5 points of the best clue; otherwise choose the best clue.
methodology.bonusGuesses: Pass after reaching the declared clue number.
methodology.operative: The bot guesser sees only centered clue-to-unrevealed-word similarities from Xenova/multilingual-e5-small.
methodology.operativeAggression: Policy comparison uses dynamic for the clue-policy rows and holds hybrid clue scoring fixed across all three operative modes.
methodology.missedTargetTiming: Clue ranking uses late missed-target timing. The fresh-target bias is based on unresolved intended targets from prior clues and fades as never-targeted friendly cards run out.
methodology.repeatedClues: The spymaster excludes every clue previously given by the same team before analysis, ranking, and fallback selection.
methodology.stalledGameResolution: After two consecutive passes, the next operative takes its highest-similarity available guess. This keeps cross-model simulations bounded and is counted separately.

operativeAggressionModes.conservative: Uses the highest similarity and separation thresholds and does not adapt to score.
operativeAggressionModes.aggressive: Uses the former production thresholds and pursues the declared clue number unless confidence is extremely low.
operativeAggressionModes.dynamic: Uses public remaining-agent counts to lower thresholds for a possible win or urgent comeback and raise them with a comfortable lead.

similarityCalibration.note: Scale and offset are applied to clue-board and board-board similarities before scoring. Cross-model operative runs retain the operative model's native scale.

methodology.rules: Every simulation uses the production Play state machine. Games that exceed the action bound remain in the report as stalls.
methodology.fallback: If the production analyzer has no ranked suggestion, use the legal indexed clue closest to one remaining agent, number 1, and count the turn.
methodology.firstHalf: For each completed game, take the first ceiling(total clue turns / 2) clue turns, then aggregate their clue numbers.

funObjective.definition: A 0-100 proxy balancing ambitious clues, productive guesses, close finishes, and a playable game length.
funObjective.caution: The Fun Index ranks deterministic self-play experiments. Human embedding agreement remains a separate validity guardrail.

policies.current: Worth + current risk adjustment + state-dependent clue-number bonus + 18 x margin.
policies.hybrid: 0.35 x Worth + 25 x expected net + 10 x success + 6 x margin + risk adjustment.
